name: Hacking Mod
description: Everyone on this server hacks, in the open. See players through walls as boxes, chams or skeletons in the colours you pick. Enemy nametags are always on, with health bars, and team mates get their own colours. Rooms can also turn recoil off. The server lists this mod, so nobody is surprised.
author: DeCombat

commands.description: Next see-through style: box, chams, skeleton.
Team mates' see-through colours on or off.
